label: Aarhus University: applicants assessed as paying

readerAccess.reason: Applies only if AU assesses you as a paying applicant; check the residence exemptions before using this route.

fee.note: Per paying applicant, not programme; non-refundable for applications after 1 November 2026. Exemptions apply.

milestones.label: AU paying applicants: final diploma, transcripts and English proof
milestones.note: Only for AU-assessed paying applicants. Your qualifying exam must be completed before this deadline, so the same-year May IB route is not available. A non-EU passport alone does not establish paying status.

milestones.label: AU paying applicants: EUR 150 application fee
milestones.note: Pay via AU Webshop and upload the receipt to each application. Non-refundable for autumn 2027 applications.

milestones.label: AU paying applicants: early answer or notice of later assessment
milestones.note: AU gives an answer or a notice by 1 June; applicants not offered early admission receive the ordinary answer on 28 July. Annual dates without an intake year.

submissionItems.label: Completed qualifying exam, final diploma/transcripts and required English proof
Application fee payment and receipt
submissionItems.destinationOfItem: AU Webshop, then receipt to each optagelse.dk application

supplementarySteps: Confirm actual paying-applicant classification with AU where residence/address conditions are unclear. AU’s paying-applicant section and fee subsection describe the address condition differently.
For applications after 1 November 2026, pay the whole first year of tuition before the first semester. Later tuition payments are per semester; follow the invoice.
